summary: 31 units (Uttarārcika 744-774). Tokens match the printed text; no invented Sanskrit; the four text_flags (760 krandaṃ, 762 uṣo, 772 devayu, 774 sunvānāsya) are sound (762 confirmed against p01/ch11 'upo ṣu'). Errors (3): 744 pitā huve rendered 'I, the father ... for you' (manual: te is most naturally 'your', pitā te = your father; no patch); 746 English translates 'of growing skill' while Hindi omits the clause; 768 English has both 'they' and 'workers' as subject, Hindi correct. Minor (13 issues): copula/verb added in Hindi (759, 767), doubled verb 765, u 'indeed' 753, pavamānāya/indave split 763, case labels 744, enā gender 749, Hindi adjective/gender confusion 751, सँवारने 768, जनों 769, madhu renderings 767/772, w gāyata vs printed gāyatā 763. 21 units ok or only minor. Confidence values honest; no 'uncertain' lines. No regrouping. Doubtful readings left as drafted: 761 apatasthuṣaḥ, 746 vide (rightly [unclear]); 750, 768, 770, 774 low. Glossary suggestions: vāyu = Vāyu (वायु); madhu = sweet drink (मधु); trita = Trita (त्रित); bhṛgu = the Bhṛgus (भृगु); makha = Makha (मख, name); haṃsa = swan (हंस); mahiṣa = buffalo (भैंसा); droṇa = trough (द्रोण); atya = courser; pavamāna Hindi = हे पवमान; ahraya = undaunted ones (निर्भीक).
